caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-toned object placed against a light beige background. The object appears to be a metal oil lamp or similar vessel. It is mostly oval in shape, with a spout or pointed end at the front and a broader, rounded base. Attached to the top is a flat lid that covers part of the upper surface, with a small, spherical knob or handle on top of the lid. Extending from the rear of the main body is a long, flat, curved handle that loops upward and forward, ending in a small circular hole, possibly for hanging. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, with shading used to suggest the metallic texture and three-dimensional form of the object. The artist's name, "PHILIP JOHNSON," is printed in small letters near the bottom left corner of the image. The composition is centered, with the object occupying the middle portion of the otherwise empty page.
title: Betty Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
